info.name: Chanor API Specification
info.description:
API documentation for Chanor Customer profile endpoints. These endpoints handle user authentication, profile management, wallet operations, transactions, and bill payments. **Authentication:** Customer endpoints require `x-apikey` header, device headers (`x-device-id`, `x-device-name`), and Bearer Token (JWT) authentication. **Optional device metadata headers:** `x-device-platform`, `x-device-os`, `x-device-model`, `x-device-manufacturer`, `x-app-version`, `x-device-location`, `x-device-city`, `x-device-state`, and `x-device-country` can also be sent during signup, login, and authenticated requests to enrich device management records.
